review_candidates.description_excerpt: Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting across virtualization, compute, operating systems, backup and recovery, monitoring, patching, and supporting hosting technologies. Serve as a technical subject matter expert for assigned infrastructure platforms, with responsibility for platform health, performance, capacity, lifecycle, and continuous improvement. eligibility_evidence: Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer and support infrastructure services hosted in Microsoft Azure as part of a hybrid enterprise hosting environment.
Experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services and hybrid-cloud environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Maintain infrastructure in accordance with enterprise technical standards, security requirements, and operational practices. Contribute technical expertise to infrastructure modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives. Promote knowledge transfer and reduce reliance on individual points of technical expertise. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant infrastructure experience. Strong hands-on engineering and troubleshooting experience with VMware virtualization technologies. Hands-on experience with Commvault enterprise backup and recovery.
